test_gaps: Static review only; no build, emulator, deployment, or runtime intent/backup tests performed.

MainActivity forwards ACTION_SEND text/plain EXTRA_TEXT to model.receive; downstream parsing, explicit user confirmation, and network cleartext guards are outside the permitted scope and were not assessed.

Manifest exports only the launcher/share activity; the dataSync service is non-exported and no provider, URI-grant capability, storage permission, or broad package visibility is declared. Runtime need for each declared network/notification/foreground-service permission was not verified.
allowBackup=false and both cloud-backup/device-transfer rules exclude all listed ordinary app-data domains; actual platform/OEM backup behavior was not exercised.
